tut.s1.b: Claude and Codex are tracked separately. The number badge is unread notifications; the pin sets which tab opens first.
tut.s2.b: The same 5-hour and weekly utilization as the /usage command. Yellow means over 70%, red pulsing means over 90%.
tut.s3.b: Today and last-7-days tokens aggregated from your local transcripts, with per-model chips.
tut.s4.b: Sessions running right now. Click a row to jump to that session's window; the folder chip opens the project folder.
tut.s5.b: Finished tasks and attention requests. The orange dot marks unread — click the row or use Mark all read. Long summaries expand with Show more.
tut.s6.b: Current version and the update check. When a new release exists you can apply it right here. Reopen this tour anytime with the ? button above.
